{{Infobox Race
|quote=<translate>A terrestrial race that makes up for its lack of innate power with versatility, perseverance and training.</translate>
|Type=<translate>Playable race</translate>
|Racial skill=<translate>Blood-Fueled Ki, Fast Learner, Adrenaline</translate>
|Forms=<translate>Super forms (Buffed, Full Power, Overdrive, Solaris), Legendary forms</translate>
|Stack forms={{L|Kaioken}}, {{L|Ultimate}}
|Strengths=<translate>Cheaper ki attacks, faster technique growth, a damage-resistant burst at low health</translate>
|Playstyle=<translate>Versatile; the only race that can become an Android</translate>
|Fusion={{L|Fusion Dance}}, {{L|Potara Earrings}}, {{L|Medi-Bug Beetles}}

<translate>
'''Humans''' are a terrestrial race with highly versatile combat skills. They lack the innate power of other races, but they are resourceful and tenacious, and overcome their limits through training and discipline. In DragonMineZ they pay for cheaper ki attacks with their own health, learn techniques faster than anyone and get a burst of adrenaline when they are close to death. Humans are also the only race that [[Special:MyLanguage/Dr. Gero|Dr. Gero]] can turn into an [[Special:MyLanguage/Android|Android]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Overview and strengths ==

* '''Cheaper ki attacks.''' Blood-Fueled Ki cuts the Ki cost of ki attacks by 25%, turning part of the saving into a health cost that comes back as bonus damage.
* '''Faster technique growth.''' Fast Learner gives your techniques 35% more experience, so they reach their upgrades sooner.
* '''A second wind.''' Adrenaline makes you tougher and faster when your health drops to 25%.
* '''Play as yourself.''' The default body type uses your own Minecraft skin.
* '''Two paths.''' A Human keeps the Super and Legendary form lines, or can trade them for the Android line through Dr. Gero's upgrade.
</translate>

<translate>
== Racial skill ==
</translate>
{{Config|General Server Config|racialSkills.human}}
<translate>
The Human racial skill has three parts. You don't need to activate any of them.
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate>Part</translate> !! <translate>What it does</translate>
|-
| <translate>'''Blood-Fueled Ki'''</translate> || <translate>Ki attacks cost '''25%''' less Ki. Part of the saved Ki is paid with your health instead ('''12.5%''' of the original cost), and that health is added as '''bonus damage''' to the attack's next hit. It never brings you below 2 health.</translate>
|-
| <translate>'''Fast Learner'''</translate> || <translate>Your techniques gain '''35%''' more experience.</translate>
|-
| <translate>'''Adrenaline'''</translate> || <translate>Dropping to '''25%''' health or below fills you with adrenaline for '''15 seconds''': you take '''30%''' less damage and gain '''+25%''' attack speed and '''+25%''' movement speed. It can trigger again after '''180 seconds''', once your health has risen back above that threshold.</translate>
|}

<translate>
An Android keeps Fast Learner and Adrenaline but replaces Blood-Fueled Ki with Android Core and Absorption Barrier (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Android#Racial skill|Android]]).
</translate>

<translate>
''Level'' is the level of the form skill (Super Forms or Legendary Forms) that unlocks the form, and ''TP cost'' is the price of that level. Each form after the first of its group also needs '''25% mastery''' on the previous one. One number in the ''STR / SKP / PWR'' column means the three stats share it. Multipliers are the defaults at 0% mastery and grow up to 1.5 times at 100% mastery. ''Ki drain'' is the base upkeep per tick; see [[Special:MyLanguage/Transformations#Energy consumption while transformed|energy consumption]] for what raises or lowers it.

'''Solaris''' is the Human top tier: the strongest Human form, but [[Special:MyLanguage/Ultimate|Ultimate]] never copies it. The '''Legendary forms''' can't be bought with TP by default: the [[Special:MyLanguage/Movies Saga|Movies Saga]] grants their levels, and Mutants can borrow them (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Transformations#Legendary forms|Legendary forms]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Becoming an Android ==
</translate>
{{Main|Android}}
<translate>
[[Special:MyLanguage/Dr. Gero|Dr. Gero]] can convert a Human into an [[Special:MyLanguage/Android|Android]], a sub-race of the Human race. The upgrade is '''permanent''': you lose the Super and Legendary forms above for good and get the Android forms (Android Base, Super Android, Fused Android) instead, and Blood-Fueled Ki is replaced by Android Core and Absorption Barrier. Think it over before you accept.
</translate>

<translate>
== Appearance ==
</translate>
{{Main|Character Customization}}
<translate>
* '''Hair:''' yes. Humans can pick any of the hairstyle presets and design their own styles in the hair editor.
* '''Gender:''' yes. Male and female body types share the same grid, so picking a body type also picks your gender.
* '''Body types:''' body type '''0''' (the default) uses your own '''Minecraft skin''', and there are extra body types for each gender. With your own skin, the '''skin pixel editor''' lets you mark your eyes and hair so your transformations can recolor them.
* '''Face:''' Humans use the human nose and mouth options, which other races can also pick.
</translate>

<translate>
== Configuration ==
</translate>
<translate>
The Human racial skill is switched on, switched off and re-balanced in the <code>human</code> section of <code>racialSkills</code> in <code>general-server.json</code>; the same section also holds the Android barrier values. The Super, Legendary and Android TP ladders are in <code>races/human/character.json</code>, and each form's multipliers, drain and requisites are in its form file.
</translate>
{{See also|General Server Config|Custom Races|Custom Forms}}
